scientific_integrity: Analytic all-source theorem. Numerical diagnostics are supportive, not an infinite-parameter proof. Prior stationary resolvent and entropy definitions credited to Bressloff (2024); publication priority is qualified.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric single membrane; homogeneous circle; independent Poisson resetting to a permeability-independent probability law; stationary interfacial entropy component, not total thermodynamic entropy. A balanced source yields zero entropy for all permeabilities. Generalized membranes, non-Poisson resets and independent validation are not covered.
title: A universal unique membrane-permeability optimizer for reset diffusion on a circle
